text:
Claire Ramos: Quick weekly follow-up on KestrelTech — they saw a cluster of repeat 502s over the last 48h, plus a noticeable spend uptick. I pulled usage trends: error rate x3 vs baseline, p95 latency up from ~420ms to ~1.2s, cost +23% this billing window. Can we confirm action owners for next steps?

Miguel Ortega: I'm on it. I triaged the traces — most failures correlate with model fallback to small-quant variant after cache misses. Repro ID: KST-502-1342. I've attached quick triage notes in the ticket.

Arjun Singh: Thanks Miguel. I can take ownership of the runtime investigation — will check routing/fallback logic and cache TTLs. Quick mitigation: bump cache TTL for KestrelTech prefix to 30s and pin their requests to the stable model variant for the next 2 hours.

Priya Patel: I notified the account and escalated renewal risk to AM. KestrelTech is worried about unpredictability — they asked for an incident postmortem and mitigation timeline. They'd prefer a canary/holdback until stabilized.

Miguel Ortega: Action items I propose: 1) Arjun: runtime rollback/pin + cache change (owner: @Arjun, ETA 1h). 2) Miguel: run targeted evals on pinned model and provide quality confirmation to customer (owner: @Miguel, ETA 3h). 3) Claire/Priya: customer comms and possible credits (owners: @Claire @Priya, ETA 6h). 4) Follow-up sync in 4h to validate metrics.

Arjun Singh: Starting mitigation now. Quick note — need the trace link and the exact prefix list from Miguel to adjust TTLs. Miguel can you paste the prefixes?

Miguel Ortega: prefixes: kestrel-org/, kestrel-org/users/, kestrel-prod/. Also the curl to pull trace: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://observability.redwood.local/traces/KST-502-1342
```

incidents-bot: Incident KST-502-1342 status updated -> mitigation_in_progress (link: https://incidents.redwood/kst/502/1342).

Arjun Singh: TTLs updated for those prefixes, pinned routing rule applied to force stable-quant variant for kestrel-prod for next 2h. I also set temporary rate-limiter to smooth bursty retries. Will monitor p95 and error-rate.

Miguel Ortega: Ran quick quality checks against pinned model, no obvious regressions in the sampled prompt set — passing 90% of our eval checks. I'll run the expanded suite and send results to the ticket.

Claire Ramos: Great — documenting owners: Arjun (runtime mitigation + postmortem), Miguel (quality checks + traces), Priya (account comms + renewal flag), Claire (credits/disposition). Follow-up sync at 4h from now. Please drop metric snapshots in the ticket before the sync. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout for kestrel-prod halted at 2026-03-20T14:18Z due to elevated error rate — rollback executed.

Priya Patel: I'll draft the customer note and include the rollback + timeline. If mitigation holds we'll propose a short SLA credit and a joint postmortem call next week.

Claire Ramos: Thanks team — if anything changes ping here. I'll capture the action list in the account tracker and set the follow-up.

Arjun Singh: Logged first pass notes for postmortem, will include root-cause candidate (cache eviction + model fallback) and metrics.

Miguel Ortega: I'll attach the expanded eval results and raw traces before the 4h sync.

Claire Ramos: Closing thread for now; will reopen after the sync with updated metrics.
